key_highlights: ASX shed $90bn in a week as surging crude prices and rate-hike fears hit miners and banks (Headlines 33, 71)
Saudi pipeline closure after Iraqi drone attack triggered oil price spike; Australian fuel prices set to rise 30c (Headlines 13, 31, 47)
AUD smashed on growth scare; iron ore entering 'bloodletting' phase (Headlines 39, 45)
RBA flagged rental inflation as key concern, complicating rate path (Headline 69)
ANZ post-3,500-job-axing restructuring faces long execution path (Headline 22)
Rio Tinto NT exit looms over by-election, signalling resource sector consolidation (Headline 16)
Mining cap-raise wave led by Canaccord signals capital-hungry exploration phase (Headline 34)
Housing market bifurcating: high-end crash vs. affordable-end resilience; first-home buyers surging (Headlines 49, 82)

sectors.trend: Sharp negative. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; ASX miners leading index losses. Cap-raise activity surging as explorers seek funding. Rio Tinto NT exit signals structural consolidation.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX under pressure from weak iron ore. Small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone Metals, Manuka Resources) showing relative strength. Gold-silver explorers (Kuniko, Gateway WA) benefit from safe-haven flows.

sectors.trend: Negative. Rising bond yields and rate-hike fears pressure valuations. ANZ restructuring post-3,500 cuts faces execution risk. RBA rental inflation concern adds policy uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX face margin pressure from higher funding costs. ANZ.AX specifically at risk from restructuring drag. Superannuation policy debate (One Nation) adds political risk to sector.

sectors.trend: Mixed-positive. Oil surge benefits producers but raises input costs. Australia softening gas supply rules eases Asian fears. Tamboran first Beetaloo gas sale is a milestone. Santos preservation noted as strategic sacrifice.
sectors.implications: Santos (STO.AX) and Woodside (WDS.AX) benefit from gas policy flexibility. TBN.AX validates Beetaloo project. Fuel cost pass-through pressures consumer staples.

sectors.trend: Negative. Woolworths price increases during 'Price Freeze' erode trust. Women's clothing chain closing 177 stores signals consumer weakness. Business confidence deteriorating.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOW.AX face margin squeeze from input costs and weak consumer spending. Retail consolidation accelerating.

sectors.trend: Neutral-positive. CSL.AX stable. AI/cloud themes active (HIVE/BUZZ HPC, Adobe record quarter). Small-cap tech (Neurizon, Iondrive) showing momentum.
sectors.implications: CSL.AX remains defensive anchor. AI infrastructure spend supports select tech names. NVDA DOJ probe adds global tech risk.

sectors.trend: Negative. High-end property seeing steepest falls; no spring bounce in auctions. Housing correction ongoing but affordable end resilient. RentTech regulatory risk in Victoria.
sectors.implications: Property REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX) under pressure from high-end weakness. First-home buyer surge supports volume but not prices. RentTech regulatory overhang a minor risk.

key_themes: Oil supply shock from Middle East driving global risk-off and rate-hike repricing
Iron ore structural weakness pressuring ASX 200 heavyweight miners
AUD weakness amplifying import costs and fuel price pass-through
RBA caught between rental inflation and growth scare
Mining sector capital-raising wave signals exploration upcycle but dilution risk
Housing market bifurcation: luxury correction vs. affordable resilience
Superannuation policy debate creating political uncertainty for financials
Consumer confidence deteriorating amid rising living costs

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price spike / Middle East escalation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; monitor Saudi-Iraq corridor; consider WDS.AX/STO.AX as relative beneficiaries
Reduce duration in rate-sensitive REITs; favour fixed-income or dividend-growth equities
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (GOLD.AX) and battery metals (CRB.AX)
Favour domestic-revenue companies; avoid high import-cost exposure in consumer staples
Avoid small-cap miners with repeated raises; focus on cash-flow-positive producers
Avoid luxury property REITs; monitor first-home buyer data for volume support

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight Australian gas/LNG producers on policy flexibility and Asian demand
opportunities.rationale: Softened gas supply rules ease Asian fears; Tamboran first gas sale validates project pipeline; oil spike supports energy complex

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into gold and battery-metals explorers as safe-haven and structural demand plays
opportunities.rationale: Risk-off environment supports gold; Critical Resources battery tech validates; Kuniko/Gateway WA gold discoveries signal exploration upcycle

opportunities.recommendation: Selective entry on ANZ.AX post-restructuring if execution milestones confirmed
opportunities.rationale: 3,500-job cut complete; cost-out benefits should flow through within 2-3 quarters; current pricing may embed excessive pessimism

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to iron ore majors; trim BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; AUD weakness and global growth scare compound downside; no near-term demand catalyst

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge rate risk in REITs and high-yield property; favour defensive dividend payers
defensive_moves.rationale: RBA rental inflation concern keeps rates elevated; high-end property correction ongoing; bond yield rise pressures valuations

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid consumer-discretionary and small-cap retail names
defensive_moves.rationale: Woolworths price increases, 177-store closures, and deteriorating business confidence signal weak consumer spending

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend losses as oil-driven inflation fears keep rate-cut expectations on hold. Iron ore weakness and AUD pressure cap upside. RBA rental inflation commentary adds policy uncertainty. Expect ^AXJO to test lower supports. Volatility elevated on Middle East headlines.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. Housing bifurcation (affordable resilience) supports consumer volume. Gas policy reform and battery-metals demand offer structural tailwinds. ANZ restructuring and mining cap-raise cycle suggest sector reset. Key risk: prolonged oil shock feeding into global recession.
key_catalysts: RBA next meeting and rental inflation data
Iron ore price trajectory (China stimulus signals)
watch_list: RBA cash rate and rental inflation data
